description: Over-temp alarm. Let spindle cool, cleaned fan grille, restarted. Filter looks dusty.
Overload on heavy cut. Tool was past wear limit. Changed tool, reduced depth of cut.
Controller froze. Rebooted. No fault found in logs.
Over-temp again. Cooled, cleaned grille. Recommend filter replacement (see WO-1013).
Drive power fault. Reset drive, found loose motor cable connector, tightened.
Over-temp third time this week. Spindle at 1290 rpm on product H. Filter clogged. Spare filter not in stock.
Chipped drill. Tool changed. Tool life counter was not reset at last change.
Over-temp, longest stop yet. Temporary fix: cleaned filter with compressed air. Needs new filter.
End mill broke at end of life. 18 parts with burrs scrapped. Tool life counter again not reset.
Replace spindle cooling fan filter. OVERDUE: waiting for spare part.
